messages:
lucy: Need a compact launch kit for next Thursday's webinar and social push. Deliverables: 3 metric tiles (latency / cost / quality), a vertical carousel (1080x1350) for IG, a 600x200 email hero, 16:9 speaker slide, and a small Q&A card. Also need an inbound-routing CSV that maps CTA variant -> campaign tag -> nurture stream. Deadline: Wed EOD.
maria: OK. Mobile-first by default. Tiles must be modular so we can swap CTAs during the review. Include per-token relative cost micro-panel (no $).
kevin: On it. Any restrictions on animation format? GIFs are fine, but prefer Lottie for the carousel if we plan interactive embeds.
lucy: Lottie preferred for carousel, but provide GIF fallback. Keep Lottie under 1MB.
kevin: Noted. I'll add Figma tokens + a small style snippet. Starter file will include separate layers for copy and alt text.
maria: Legal flagged a recent issue with comparative claims. Use qualifying phrasing only. Also need WCAG AA contrast for 12px labels.
legal: Confirmed. Avoid absolute claims like "cheapest" or "fastest." Use "latency-optimized" / "cost-efficient." Mark metrics as p95 or p50 and include methodology footnote with link to the harness. Also include a short accessibility description for each image.
l10n: For FR and JA localization provide a CSV with context columns (character limit, where used). Short CTAs only (<= 18 chars).
lucy: Also include two CTA variants for A/B: "Register" and "Watch & Demo" mapped in the inbound-routing CSV. We need campaign tags for both.
kevin: Will include CTA layers and export a CSV mapping: asset_id, cta_variant, campaign_tag, nurture_stream.
maria: Add a tiny Q&A card layout with collapsible bullets for the slide pack (one-screen view). Keep copy minimal.
kevin: Uploading starter Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch-mini-kit-181555. Artboards: tiles, carousel-lottie, slide, qa-card, csv-strings.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-4012 "launch-mini-kit". Owners: @kevin. Due 2025-06-11. Exports requested: PNGs (600x600 tiles), vertical carousel 1080x1350, email hero 600x200, slide 1920x1080, Lottie <1MB, GIF fallback, SVG icons, strings CSV.
maria: Great. Please include alt text & an accessibility note for each asset, and an asset manifest listing filenames and intended usage.
kevin: Will include manifest JSON and a small README in the Figma file.
l10n: Once copy is final, I'll coordinate FR/JA translations and return CSVs.
maria: First pass requested by Tue 11am PT so we can run legal & accessibility checks. Tag me on upload. :rocket: 
kevin: First pass ETA Tue 10:30am PT. Will ping here with link.
lucy: Thanks team  This set feeds webinar slides, social carousel, and inbound email flows — please keep modules flexible for quick swaps during live review.
